Frequently asked questions

How many entry-level and new-grad jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 577 open entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States as of November 24, 2026.

How much do entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $81,425–$112,000 a year, based on 131 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include PwC (48 listings), SynergisticIT (45 listings), Cengage Group (34 listings), Cadmus (33 listings), and SalesDraft Recruiting (30 listings).

Do any entry-level and new-grad jobs in the United States mention visa sponsorship or OPT?

1 listing mentions visa sponsorship or OPT/CPT. A mention does not guarantee sponsorship or eligibility; confirm with the employer.

Do I need experience?

1 listings mention 0–2 years and 0 say no experience required. Other requirements vary; review the original posting. A title match alone does not confirm eligibility.
